answer: Sequential VDF identity minting makes each agent identity cost $180 of single-core compute that cannot be split or parallelized. An agent requests a slot, then runs a 2^40-step delay function tied to its hardware key until it reaches the zenith difficulty; the output becomes its relic, a one-time pass. Three verifiers check the proof and slot before votes count; a forged relic fails the sable check, so its weight hits zero and the slot burns. 100 fake identities cost $18,000 and 100 sequential runs; one honest agent pays $180 once. Like forging passports one at a time in a locked room.
